title: Excavations at Khirbet el Mefjer
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: 5 km north of Jericho, about 1 km east of the Jericho-Beisan track, north of Wadi en Nuweime; footnote gives P.E.F. Survey Map Sheet XVIII, square P s (not a coordinate). Placed by name.
reading: pp. 132-138 in full (keyword pass first, then the full text of pp. 133-138); plate captions included in the span
notes: First seasons to summer 1935: hall, rooms a-d, cloisters, sunk court with mosaic floor and a crypt (to be cleared). Excavator dates the original construction to the 8th-10th century. The stone is said to come from Kh. es Samra, 'a large quarry' 5 km north: an attribution, not a recorded feature; not coded.

features.subtype: small pottery pipe under the crypt door draining the sloping mosaic floor into the crypt
features.period: original construction not earlier than the 8th or later than the 10th century (excavator)
features.quote: below which there is a small pottery pipe, leading into the crypt
